title: Understanding Residual Plots
text: A residual plot shows the residuals on the vertical axis and the independent variable on the horizontal axis. It helps to assess the fit of a regression model.

title: Interpreting the Residual Plot
text: Look for patterns in the residual plot. A random scatter of points suggests a good fit, while patterns indicate potential issues with the model.

title: Identifying Patterns
text: In the residual plot, if the residuals are consistently above or below the horizontal line, it indicates that the model is consistently underpredicting or overpredicting.

hintAnswer: The residuals are mostly above the horizontal line.
title: Analyzing the Residual Plot
text: Based on the residual plot, are the residuals mostly above or below the horizontal line?
choices: The residuals are mostly above the horizontal line.
The residuals are mostly below the horizontal line.

title: Conclusion from the Residual Plot
text: What does it mean if the residuals are mostly above the horizontal line?
choices: The model is a good fit.
